book.name: Lucas
book.title: Evangelio según Lucas Jesucristo roy pjl̈ú ëre, e jyã tara Lucasdë

content: Woyde ga l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëy l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ëy, ga rayëy

Eshko ga nopga l̈öng kjl̈öbö tjl̈ẽ Jesús kong ga «Galilea sopga l̈öng kjl̈öbö öng zrök, sho suya, pjë dret Sbö kong wl̈o. E wopro ga nopga ichara bi pjl̈uyo Pilatorë ba zrök, ga zröra l̈ok eshko» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «¿Pjãy wotjl̈ĩk ga Galilea sopga l̈i zröraba, epga owa, nopga obl̈ë ba kjokshko so kjinmo kjĩshko l̈ëmire?
L̈ër bomi kong ga eni l̇l̇ëme. Gueniyo l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëmi l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ozĩ, ga rayozĩa. L̇l̇ëm ga pjãy pjir bakoe.

¿E ga pjãy wotjl̈ĩk ga nopga wol̈ono Siloé kjokyo dogl̈o sak kjwara kjingsho kjwong (18), ak sho jong kjókshko eshko l̈i dgono jer ba kjing goshko l̈i, e owa, Jerusalén sopga l̇l̇amo l̈i kjinmo l̈ëmire?
L̈ër bomi kong ga eni l̇l̇ëme. Gueniyo l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëmi l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ozĩ, ga rayozĩa. L̇l̇ëm ga pjãy pjir bakoe» l̈e.
Kjor jong kjl̈ara, botjyë l̇l̇ëme

E irgo ga tjl̈ẽno nopga kong l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go. Tjl̈ẽ ga «Domer shäng kjl̈ara, kjor jong kjl̈ara, ba kjil̇l̇gwo bo ara kjokyo l̈i tjrëko. Kjor l̈i ko higuera. Dbar kjwara ga jek jëk shäng e go, bo tjokde ĩya wl̈o, gueniyo bo drete.
Eni ga tjl̈ẽ ba kjok daga l̈i kong ga “Kuzong. Eeri ga öötong l̈u pjl̈ogl̈o mya ga kjor kjwe ĩnshko ga bo wl̈ẽn kjwara l̇l̇ëme. ¡Kjwe kö̃zong! ¿Shto kjrë jong ara l̇l̇ënoro?” l̈e ba parkaga l̈i kong.
»Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Tjl̈apga, wẽyẽ. Rayos ber jong l̈u pjl̈ara obi, sor pokër, ga dwl̈omner,
botjyëre ĩy wl̈o, l̇l̇ëm ga köm eshko jã ga pjl̈úe” l̈e ba pjl̈u kong» l̈e.
Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo ga wal̈ë poptara Jesúsdë kjl̈ara
Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo kjwara ga Jesús sök oba ping judíoga syõ uyo jong kjwara l̈i roshko.
Wal̈ë sök kjl̈ara eshko, swl̈o ara l̈u pjl̈ogl̈o sak kjwara kjingsho kjwong (18) tjän, wl̈oyo Ä sëya kjl̈ararë. Wal̈ë l̈i beno shäng wozönge.
Ĩya Jesúsdë ga rokara tek ba shwoy, ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pja döktong, pja rayara bop swl̈o wl̈erë» l̈e,
ga orkwo iono ba go. Jekdo eshko ga wal̈ë l̈i poptono beno shäng kjl̈o bek ba shtoshko. Ga opyono beno shäng Sbö poshrëk.

Gueniyo judíoga syõ uyo kägäyo l̈i shäng eshko. Ĩya ga iirkono ara, tjl̈ẽ nopga l̈öng l̈i kong ga «Shji parkozl̈ong dbaryo iak l̈ok kjwo tjer (6). Pjãy poptë woydë ga pjãy tek eshko dbaryo ga pjl̈úe. Gueniyo woshtozl̈ong dbaryo l̈ira l̇l̇ëme» l̈e.

Kuya Jesúsdë ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «¡Pjãy Sbö tjl̈õkwo söga jl̈õkoyo l̈ëmi, gueniyo pjãy wotjl̈ĩk owa bomi pjl̈úshko! Wal̈ë kjwe, e Abraham tjëyo, ga tjeng Ä wl̈oshko eeri ga öötong l̈u pjl̈ogl̈o sak kjwara kjingsho kjwong (18). ¿Pjãy uunkong bomi öng dök, sömi di ië woshtozl̈ong dbaryo l̇l̇ëmdo? ¿Eni ga wal̈ë kjwe döror Ä wl̈oshko dwayo dbar ëreshko ga owa l̈ëmi sorëro?» l̈e.
Kuya ba wl̈oyoga l̈irë ga l̈ökkjrono ara. Gueniyo l̇l̇amoga l̈öng l̈ira beno l̈öng wopjl̈ú, l̇l̇ëbo shäryara kës l̈i kjĩshko.
Kjor dwl̈ayo chirawa
Eshko ga Jesús tjl̈ẽ l̈öng l̈i kong ga «¿Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo sorë, e so l̇l̇ë kjoyo? ¿L̈ër bomi kong sorë ga pjl̈ú?
E so kjor dwl̈ayo chirawa ko mostaza dgoroy kl̈ung roy kjoyoe. Kuno ga kësbang, kjor wl̈eni. Eshko ga sënwa l̇l̇ë usho ywë ba kowo go» l̈e.
Pjl̈ung shosho uukkl̈o
E irgo ga tjl̈ẽ ga «¿Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo sorë, e so l̇l̇ë kjoyo?
E so wal̈ë pjl̈ung shosho l̇l̇runo bayo ara ba uukkl̈o tjok, ga ie ber buk uur wl̈o kjoyoe. Ba uukkl̈o shdöktong pjl̈ung shosho l̈i kjwang jĩkong» l̈e.
Kjër bäng bam chira
Jesús to jek shäng Jerusalén kjokyo wl̈o l̈e. Eshko ga jëk shäng irbo goshko ga äär kjok kjrina kjrinashko ga sl̈an oba ping.
Pjl̈ara ga no kjl̈ara l̇l̇ëbo kjakrokono ba kong. Tjl̈ẽ ga «Tjl̈apga, ¿no kjre Sbörë där wl̈o l̈i kjl̈öbö döre?»
«Pjãy drön ëë, pjãy opzrëk jek kjër bäng bam chira l̈i go wl̈o. L̈ër bomi kong ga nopga ara opzrëk woydë jek e go wl̈o, gueniyo jek ga äe.

U sogo l̈i u bäng bängzano pjir ga pjãy beno l̈öng kjoko l̈i, u bäng l̈i porwëmi kjöw kjöw, ga öö l̈ëmi, pjãy tjl̈ẽ ga “Tjl̈apga, u bäng dös borwa kong sira” l̈ëmi eni. »Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ bomi kong ga “Pjãy ë, pjãy kjone so, e miydër l̇l̇ëme” l̈e.
»Eshko ga pjãy tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Dënashko ga tjawa iono bop tjok, ga oba pinop borwa kjokshko bakoe” l̈ëmi eni.
»Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ bomi kong ga “Pjãy ë, pjãy kjone so, e miydër l̇l̇ëme. Pjãy l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryaga eröe. Pjãy opkjos bor shwoy ëre dwayo” l̈e.

»Eshko ga Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈agaga l̈öng kës l̈i, e ber l̈öng Sbö sök no pjl̈uyo ĩyado l̈ishko. Ga nopga kjok kjwang jĩkong so sirkek äär ber l̈öng ië ba tjok. Ĩmi eni ga pjãy iak beno tjeng kjoko kjĩshko ga pjãy ber tjeng sl̈ar eshko, kowo uë, l̇l̇ëbo bang ara bomi kong kjĩshko.
Eerishko ga kjong kjong tjwl̈õ ara l̈i, e ber l̈öng tjwl̈õ chira eshko. E ga eerishko ga kjong kjong tjwl̈õ chira l̈i, e ber l̈öng tjwl̈õ ara eshko» l̈e.
Jesús sl̈atong Jerusalén sopga kjĩshko
Eshko ga fariseoga shrono l̈öng kjl̈öbö, ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pjl̈u Herodes, pja zröya woydë. E kjĩshko ga pja nom jũy dwayo» l̈e.

Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Domer l̈ëmi l̈öng l̈i, e oba jyãpgwaga erä. Pjãy nom ba shwoy, ga pjãy tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Eeri, bong ga tja shäng Ä sëyaga tjeng oba goshko l̈i ichë to, ga tja shäng oba poptë bakoe. Pak shäryër wl̈o l̈i, e pjir kjönma” l̈ëmi ba kong eni.
Gueniyo ga eeri, bong, kjönma ga tja to jek shäng Jerusalén kjokyo wl̈o. Tek këgongshko ga Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈agaga zröraba shtoyo eshko.

»¡Jerusalén sopga, tja kuzĩa! Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈agaga zrömi. Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy l̈agaga ichara bomi kong l̈i l̈ömi ak go, zrömi wl̈o. Woydoror enido ga pjãy tön, kjörkö meyo ba wapga töno tjeng ba sjä̃gä dirko wl̈eni, gueniyo woydoromi l̇l̇ëme.
Tja kuzĩa. Bomi u, e raye Sbörë ber jong tjoksa. L̈ër bomi kong ga tja ëre ĩmi ame, äär jong pjãy tjl̈ẽ l̈öng ga
